name: Power-Assisted Bicycle
description: A bicycle with an electric motor (bicyclette assistée), which on public highways must have a motor rated 500 W or less that stops assisting at 32 km/h, pedals that work at all times, and two or three wheels; the assist may come from pedalling or a throttle.

restrictions.rule: Handlebars, pedals, two or three wheels on the ground, and an electric motor powered by a rechargeable battery; never a gasoline motor
The rider must be able to pedal it at all times like an ordinary bicycle; the assist may be started by pedalling or by a throttle

On public highways it must meet the federal power-assisted bicycle standards the Code still points to, though they were repealed in 2021: a motor rated no more than 500 W that stops assisting at 32 km/h, past which only the rider's own pedalling can take it faster
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 492.2; Motor Vehicle Safety Regulations, C.R.C., c. 1038, s. 2(1), as it read before February 4, 2021

restrictions.rule: Must bear the manufacturer's power-assisted bicycle label; a bicycle converted with a kit needs a motor labelled with its continuous power rating and maximum rpm
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, ss. 274.2, 492.2

restrictions.rule: A conversion motor may be sold only with an on/off switch separate from the throttle, or a mechanism that keeps it from engaging below 3 km/h
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 274.2

restrictions.rule: Carries an identification number, which needn't be a 17-character VIN
Riders must be 18 or older, or 14 to 17 with a class 6D moped licence
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, ss. 67, 492.2

restrictions.rule: Every rider must wear a helmet with a rigid shell, padded interior and chin strap, correctly adjusted and fastened
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 492.2; Protective Helmets Regulation, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 6, ss. 2.1, 3

restrictions.rule: Ridden under the rules for cyclists: no earphones, no passenger without a fixed seat for one, and no sidewalks unless a sign allows it
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, ss. 443.2, 485, 492.1

restrictions.rule: Not allowed on limited-access highways or their entrance and exit ramps
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 479

restrictions.rule: Banned from public highways if it looks like a motorcycle or moped, lacks a federal compliance label, and has footrests or a platform, motorcycle-style wheels and tires, a body covering its frame with no height-adjustable saddle, or a motor able to exceed 32 km/h or 500 W
restrictions.citation: Ministerial Order 2024-24, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 0.1.3, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Not a road vehicle: it isn't registered, and adults need no licence
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, ss. 4, 6, 65

restrictions.rule: The public automobile insurance plan covers its rider's injuries only when a moving vehicle the plan covers is involved
Off-road it's exempt from the off-highway vehicle rules, unless it qualifies as a moped or motorcycle
restrictions.citation: Act respecting off-highway vehicles, CQLR c V-1.3, s. 4
